title: Totem of Creepet
description: Change the default Totem of Undying to something much cuter!
body:
![Totem of Creepet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/613cf4e098b6f0ab78244a91a44447f4a1fd7b23.png)

Dont like the default totem? Need something new to try out? Then say hello to Totem of Creepet!


## What does it do?

This resource pack changes the normal Totem of Undying to the Totem of Creepet!

![Totem of Undying and Creepet Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4ce3ae18b579636a3b049d7a4894e033cc66958c.gif)


## Does it work before 1.21.11?

Yes, but its a bit weird. The resource pack with the outline breaks in 1.15, because the outline of the totem swallows the rest of it, which makes the totem brown and weird, the solution is to download the Outline OFF version, which fixes it. Below 1.13, the totem just breaks, and the custom model just poofs away. I tried to fix it but no matter what i did, the resource pack would just refused to work.


## What is Italian Brainrot?

TRALALERO TRALALA, ORCALERO ORCALA. Idk google it i guess
